context: A police officer briefs a manager on relocation compliance rules
purpose: Teach: 引越し/倉庫/拠点/敷地/保管/申告/在宅/移住

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本日は管轄区域での引越し手続きについてご説明に伺いました。
lines.en: Today I came to explain relocation procedures in our jurisdiction.
lines.style: Formal, measured tone with official police bearing

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。実は来月、本社の拠点を移転する予定なんです。
lines.en: Thank you. Actually, we plan to relocate our headquarters next month.
lines.style: Polite businesslike reply with slight nervousness underneath

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: なるほど。新しい敷地内に倉庫も建設されるとのことですね。
lines.en: I see. I hear a warehouse will also be built on the new premises.
lines.style: Methodical confirmation, reading from official notes carefully

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、危険物の保管エリアも含まれていますので、申告が必要でしょうか。
lines.en: Yes, it includes a hazardous materials storage area, so do we need to declare it?
lines.style: Cautious inquiry showing genuine concern about compliance

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: もちろんです。書類の提出は引越し当日の十日前までにお願いします。
lines.en: Of course. Please submit the paperwork at least ten days before moving day.
lines.style: Direct instruction delivered with authoritative civic clarity

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: わかりました。一部の社員は在宅勤務を続けて、地方へ移住する者もおります。
lines.en: Understood. Some employees will continue remote work, and some will relocate to the countryside.
lines.style: Informative update spoken with measured professional courtesy

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: その場合も住所変更を必ずご案内ください。何かあればこの番号へどうぞ。
lines.en: In those cases please always notify them to change their address. Call this number if anything comes up.
lines.style: Reassuring close balancing firmness with helpfulness
